claims.statement: The checked Earth footprint is 1,024 by 1,024 metres at one-metre terrain spacing.
Route elevations, open-ground regions, and sightline occlusions are computed from the checked DTM, lidar surface, and orthophoto registration. Lidar surface is not used as a walkability mask.
Public event guidance places check-in at the gate, lets arrivals drive to a selected site to unload or settle a car-camping site, and requires tent campers to move vehicles to designated parking.
Lower and upper tent campers return through the lower gate, park in the west upper field, and walk back; lower car campers keep the car at camp; Middle Earth is not camping.

Austen traced a direct upper-to-middle connector and a clear middle-to-lower connector over the registered orthophoto; Gate 1 source-locks those vertices and composes them with short open-tier approaches.
Exact Gate 1 stops, road centerlines, campsite examples, and other non-traced placements are registered proposals over measured terrain, not centimetre-accurate field survey.
The useful task, night transformation, final choice, and route presentation are gameplay proposals.

The Gate 1 night-heart mast was an art-direction proposal only and has been superseded in Gate 3 by a low fire-jam focal plane plus a separate LED circle; no Gate 1 sightline result depends on either treatment.

The playable Gate 2 browser runtime renders and collides against the full one-metre DTM. Its four-metre GLB terrain is an offline review surface with measured interpolation error and is not runtime collision authority.

Gate 2's visible canopy screen contains 95,459 one-metre cells derived from checked lidar occupancy at least four metres above the DTM plus an explicit 18 metre conservative gameplay dilation. Dilation-only cells are removed from all seven registered clearings, and every approved person and staged vehicle corridor is carved with audited physical clearance. It does not assert individual trees or buildings.
Gate 3 preserves the Gate 2 coordinate fingerprint and locks all five approved review-camera positions, targets, and 65 degree horizontal fields of view across day, dusk, and night.

The current visual revision retains Gate 3's 427 checked lidar canopy centers while distributing twelve accepted Forest and PlantFactory tree families. Thirty-four high-detail PlantFactory trees remain sparse habitat accents; the centers and family assignments remain interpreted visual ecology, not surveyed tree trunks or species.

The temporary tents, vehicles, 16-person fire-circle perimeter, eight active flow artists, fire treatment, and separate LED canopy are authored festival fiction. The bridge and permanent structures remain source-unlocked and absent from Gate 3.

Gate 4 makes one representative night-heart slice interactive: the player parks a physical EUC, enters on foot, joins a responsive fire jam, completes the turn, and restores the completed state plus parked collider after reload.

Gate 5 integrates the registered lower gate, selected camp, west parking, Middle Earth fire circle, festival exit and re-entry, and final selected-camp return in one persisted journey. Capture-only landmark staging is explicitly separated from the inherited continuous route and collider proof.

Gate 6 converts opt-in WGS84 device fixes through the checked EPSG:26916 coordinate frame into the existing world. Nominal registered-route fixes may stage the player; poor-accuracy and stale fixes remain visible but cannot move it.

The living Middle Earth revision keeps an open fire-performance floor and arrival wedge while a deterministic community rotates five fire artists through three active slots, moves perimeter spectators, preserves social pairs, spatializes the fire, LED circle, and crowd, and applies measured-terrain attitude to the third-person electric unicycle.

The Forest ecology acceptance revision reuses twelve Forest and PlantFactory tree families, two extracted Forest grass prototypes, rooted wind, Forest ground-life assets, and the shared Forest lighting rig around the measured Flow Fest terrain. It imports no Forest clearing layout and records 427 trees, 20,798 grass instances, 19 ground-life instances, 34 PlantFactory accents, and zero registered-route intrusions.

Mounted EUC traversal uses a separate 42 degree climb envelope and grounded surface-velocity reconciliation. A checked browser regression climbed from a 37.06 degree DTM sample, traveled 13.30 metres in 2.5 seconds, and gained 1.22 metres of ground elevation without ending collision-limited.
